description: Supplemental Data for "Improving Water Main Asset Management with the Hydraulic Impact Factor: A Risk-Based Case Study from Sugar Land is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Alence Poudel (City of Sugar Land). Supplemental Data as Appendix for ASCE JWRPM paper "Improving Water Main Asset Management with the Hydraulic Impact Factor: A Risk-Based Case Study from Sugar Land". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: XML. Size stated: 620729. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
